title: Ecological Pyramid
definition: A graphical representation of the relationship between different organisms at different trophic levels in an ecosystem, depicting the flow of energy, biomass, or population numbers.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims to assess conceptual clarity on ecosystem dynamics, energy flow, and trophic efficiency; essential for Mains answers on biodiversity and climate change.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ecological Pyramid.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
